description: Defines the class 'time_alignment_estimator_dft_impl', a DFT-based implementation of a time alignment estimator used in PHY support, including methods for estimating time alignment from symbols and buffers, and managing DFT processors.

classes.name: time_alignment_estimator_dft_impl
classes.description: A class implementing a DFT-based time alignment estimator, managing DFT processors, and providing estimation methods.

methods.name: time_alignment_estimator_dft_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DFT processors collection.

methods.name: estimate
methods.description: Estimates time alignment measurement from symbol spans or buffers, with optional stride and maximum TA constraints.

methods.name: get_idft
methods.description: Selects the appropriate DFT processor based on required resource elements.

methods.name: estimate_ta_correlation
methods.description: Calculates time alignment from correlation data assuming symbols are pre-processed.
